items.name: Barricade
items.effect: Blocks zombie pathing and absorbs damage so a lane slows down before it reaches players.
items.bestUse: Buying breathing room when a wave starts pushing through one approach.
items.placementNote: Place it at a natural funnel with player or turret coverage behind it.
items.availability: Starter or basic run gear in current source lists

items.name: Steel Barricade
items.effect: Creates a stronger pathing block with more durability than a normal barricade.
items.bestUse: Holding chokepoints where zombies need to stall in front of team damage.
items.placementNote: Use it to shape a lane first, then protect it with turret angles or teammates.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Bunker
items.effect: Places a fortress shelter where players inside become invincible, regenerate HP, and gain a damage boost.
items.bestUse: Stabilizing the squad when dense waves or elite pressure would otherwise force a wipe.
items.placementNote: Drop it where teammates can keep firing from safety without blocking escape paths.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Auto Turret
items.effect: Automatically targets and shoots nearby zombies for steady extra damage.
items.bestUse: Covering a lane while players reload, kite, or watch another angle.
items.placementNote: Set it behind protection so it keeps firing instead of getting destroyed early.
items.availability: Listed in Survivor and Engineer gear sources

items.name: Flame Turret
items.effect: Sprays fire in a cone and burns multiple zombies when they group together.
items.bestUse: Punishing tight chokepoints where zombie packs move through the same space.
items.placementNote: Angle it across the funnel, not into open ground with low traffic.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Vanguard Turret
items.effect: Places a heavy turret that targets the strongest zombie with high single-target damage.
items.bestUse: Anchoring a defensive lane when elites or tougher zombies need priority damage.
items.placementNote: Protect it with barricades and keep players close enough to clear smaller enemies.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Laser Turret
items.effect: Auto-tracks zombies and fires fast red lasers at range.
items.bestUse: Adding reliable ranged pressure around a Bastion defensive hold.
items.placementNote: Keep the fight inside its firing lanes so the tracking damage stays active.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Drone
items.effect: Creates a hovering combat drone that auto-shoots zombies and can soak damage for the player.
items.bestUse: Adding mobile pressure and extra safety around Bastion setups.
items.placementNote: Stay close enough to the fight for the drone's shots and damage soak to matter.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Landmine
items.effect: Detonates when zombies step on it and deals area damage.
items.bestUse: Stopping a packed push right before it reaches a barricade or player route.
items.placementNote: Put it on predictable paths or breach points, not random empty floor.
items.availability: Starter or basic run gear in current source lists
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Spikes
items.effect: Extends spikes from the ground periodically to damage nearby zombies.
items.bestUse: Softening enemies that are already being held in a chokepoint.
items.placementNote: Place it where zombies stay long enough for repeated spike hits.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Shockwave Bomb
items.effect: Releases a shockwave that knocks back and stuns zombies.
items.bestUse: Buying recovery time when a dense pack is about to break the defensive line.
items.placementNote: Use it on grouped zombies so the knockback and stun affect the whole push.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Mending Tower
items.effect: Continuously heals nearby structures within its radius.
items.bestUse: Keeping barricades and turrets alive during structure-heavy team holds.
items.placementNote: Place it behind the defensive line so it repairs without taking direct pressure.
items.imageStatus: missing exact clean local gear image

items.name: Healing Station
items.effect: Continuously heals players standing within its radius.
items.bestUse: Sustaining teammates who need to hold a firing lane through chip damage.
items.placementNote: Keep it near the team's hold point but behind the front barricades.
